activities.title: Cook at the Community Feast
activities.description: Build reputation toward missing toys, then visit the reward vendor.
steps: Check Pleeqi for Community Feast while the event is running. Accept it if offered.
Follow Big Kinook’s orders until the quest’s tasks are complete.
Return to Pleeqi and turn it in.
activities.prerequisite: Follow the in-game quest and vendor requirements; unreported access stays unknown.
activities.reason: Keep reputation and purchases on your preferred main; toy ownership stays account-wide.

toyRoute.notes: The weekly quest is separate from repeatable feast participation. Check the event on the in-game map; no live event timer is assumed.
